page.overview:
What is Spit Out the Bone?

Spit Out the Bone is the twelfth and final track from Metallica's tenth studio album Hardwired...to Self-Destruct. It was written by James Hetfield and Lars Ulrich.

The phrase "spit out the bone" (sometimes said as "chew the meat and spit out the bones") means to take useful information or knowledge from something while ignoring the parts that are not helpful, wrong, or hard to understand. It's about getting to the main point and leaving out the extra stuff. The subject matter of the song deals with people combining with technology and losing their physical form, which represents how we depend on technology and sacrificing our uniqueness for ease.

Come unto me and you will feel perfection Come unto me and dedicate Come unto me, you'll never feel rejection Come unto me and terminate Remove your heart, it's only good for bleeding Bleeding through your fragile skin Remove your thought cause it's only for deceiving Deceiving thoughts destroy within Disappear like man was never here

Long live machine The future supreme Man overthrown Spit out the bone
